notes.title: Next Fest Demo Out Now！
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Paracosm Narration here, and we're happy to announce our first indie narrative game, A Chronicle of Occultism in Skinnerburg, has joined Next Fest and is open for demo play now! We hope you enjoy it!

Feel free to download the demo and add to your wishlist!

If you have any questions or suggestions, please join the QQ group: 985847256 or join our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/qzhDGpjyFp


Have a good time in Skinnerburg!
